data.name: Dataram
data.gender_notes: Dataram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dataram is derived from Sanskrit words ‘da’ meaning ‘give’ and ‘tram’ meaning ‘knowledge’. This name signifies the one who bestows the knowledge of the universe. The name Dataram carries the meaning “God of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Dataram usually hope their child will grow to embody god of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Dataram is a revered name in Hinduism and is associated with Lord Mahavishnu, who is the preserver of the universe. This name is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge, and power to the person.
data.etymology: Dataram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dataram total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dataram is rooted in the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism, which values knowledge and wisdom above all. It conveys the idea of a teacher or a sage who imparts insightful knowledge to his/her students, thereby expanding their horizons and broadening their understanding of the world. In Hindu society, the guru-shishya (teacher-student) relationship is highly revered, and the guru is considered a source of wisdom and enlightenment. The name Dataram reflects this deeply ingrained respect for knowledge and the reverence accorded to those who possess it and share it with others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dataram signifies one who dispels ignorance and bestows the light of knowledge upon the seeker. The name is often used as an epithet for the Hindu deity, Datta (one of the three aspects of God, known as the compassionate and bestower of boons), who is revered as the giver of knowledge and blessings. The name Dataram highlights the importance of knowledge in the spiritual journey, as it enables us to gain a deeper understanding of ourselves, the universe, and ultimately, the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dataram: The abode of God within oneself. A name that invokes the constant awareness and remembrance of the divine presence within.
